final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT ID, COUNT(*) as count FROM Laboratory GROUP BY ID), step2 AS (SELECT SUM(count) as total_sum FROM step1), step3 AS (SELECT s1.ID, s1.count, CAST(s1.count AS REAL) / CAST(s2.total_sum AS REAL) as ratio FROM step1 s1 CROSS JOIN step2 s2 WHERE s2.total_sum IS NOT NULL), step4 AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) as avg_ratio FROM step3) SELECT s3.ID, s3.count, s3.ratio, s3.ratio - s4.avg_ratio as difference FROM step3 s3 CROSS JOIN step4 s4 WHERE s4.avg_ratio IS NOT NULL ORDER BY difference IS NULL, difference DESC LIMIT 10
